findings.text: Fair enqueue entry accepts a runqueue task and flag set and leaves hierarchical fair accounting consistent with utilization estimates and running counts reflecting the arrival. Throttled arrivals may remain parked outside the ordering structure, delayed arrivals follow a requeue path, current entities receive placement without reinsertion, and other eligible arrivals end ordered with adjusted weight and deadline distance. Frequency hinting for input waiters plus overutilized bookkeeping for non new tasks plus tick refresh occur as accompanying effects.

Fair dequeue entry removes a task from fair control and reports whether removal completed. Already throttled tasks follow a limbo removal path that always reports success, while other tasks conditionally withdraw utilization estimates unless delayed and then rely on underlying hierarchical removal to decide the result. Delayed removal invalidates further task references by the caller.

Placement derives start virtual time as a base value reduced by a load scaled lag term, where scaling grows with combined queue and entity weight and is guarded against empty load. Dominant entity weight relative to queue load triggers a refresh of the shared zero reference to bound later weighted differences. Relative deadline requests convert to absolute deadline and clear the relative marker, new arrivals under a feature gate receive a reduced initial deadline distance, and otherwise deadline equals start plus full slice.

Entity attach maintains synchronization between entity and queue load views, refreshes runnable and group share views, records accounting and statistics, and marks the entity present. Transition of queue occupancy from empty to nonempty additionally ensures throttle state assessment, leaf membership, and correction of throttled PELT clock bookkeeping where applicable, while migrated arrivals lose their prior hotness marker.

Current entity handoff preserves a single outstanding current pointer per queue. Taking over as current finalizes waiting time and load sync for entities already present, starts current statistics, clears prior maximum slice tracking context and records a fresh execution baseline. Yielding the current role brings execution time up to date for still present predecessors, restarts waiting time and load sync, and clears the current pointer with an expectation that the yielded entity matches the recorded one.

Periodic tick for the current entity keeps runtime statistics and hierarchical load and share views current. Under high resolution tick configuration a queued tick further requests rescheduling without additional validation, while other ticks have no further effect in the shown fragment.

Throttling moves tasks between runnable and parked limbo membership. Throttle work parks the invoking throttled task after verifying class and active throttle state, marking it throttled only after removal and requesting rescheduling. Parked tasks leave limbo on sleep with the marker cleared, on migration with load detached, or on unthrottle completion where they are dequeued from limbo and reenqueued unless higher level throttling reappears. Group throttle depth counts nested requests so only outermost transitions change queue membership and clocks.

Unthrottle completion for a level requires current time to be current, decrements the nested throttle depth, and only proceeds when depth reaches zero. It reconciles PELT and self throttled clock accumulations, drains parked tasks through a temporary list to tolerate reentrant throttling during reenqueue, returns unprocessed tasks to limbo when rethrottling occurs, and restores leaf membership unless the queue has fully decayed.

Runtime distribution grants bandwidth to throttled queues under global pool limits and arranges asynchronous unthrottling on the owning processor. Local targets may be refreshed and unthrottled directly while remote targets are queued for cross processor delivery with duplicate queueing avoided. Queues already scheduled, no longer throttled, or left without positive remainder after a bounded grant do not proceed, and the overall result indicates whether any throttling remains.

Throttle work serializes parking against migration and class changes by holding the task runqueue lock across state checks plus clock refresh plus removal plus limbo insertion plus rescheduling. Distribution traverses the throttled set under read side protection while holding each target runqueue lock during per queue checks and updates and a separate bandwidth lock only around global pool deduction. Asynchronous unthrottle entry expects the target runqueue lock already held by the caller.

High resolution fair tick arms a preemption timer only when the feature and queue enablement both hold, the donor task belongs to the fair class, no timer is already active, and more than one entity is queued. The armed interval reflects remaining virtual distance to deadline converted by entity weight and adjusted upward for interrupt load share. Overdue virtual deadlines for the current donor instead request immediate rescheduling without arming.

Disabled build configurations replace throttling and high resolution tick helpers with inert variants. Throttle enqueue checks plus throttled dequeue plus high resolution start and update become no operation effects, throttled enqueue reports no deferral, and fair tick enablement reports false, so callers retain uniform call shape without behavioral effect.

Delayed and hierarchical enqueue preserve count and ordering consistency. Hierarchical attach ensures each ancestor level has current time refreshed, attaches absent entities or refreshes present ones, and increments queued plus runnable plus idle depth counters with idle propagation and weight propagation toward the root. Delayed requeue reevaluates lag and only when changed temporarily withdraws ordering membership to replace placement before restoring counts and load sync and clearing the delayed marker.

Detachment removes load influence when leaving a queue. Tasks whose averaging state was never attached require no action, covering unawakened forks and pending wakeups. Otherwise detachment synchronizes load views, withdraws entity load, refreshes group aggregates, and propagates the change upward.

Enqueue time throttle assessment applies only when bandwidth control is globally in use and the target queue is runtime enabled without an active current entity and not already throttled. Eligible queues receive a runtime allocation refresh with zero consumed delta, while all other cases leave state unchanged.

Overutilized marking is monotonic at root domain granularity in the shown path. A domain not already flagged becomes flagged when the local processor satisfies the overutilized predicate, otherwise no change occurs, and the marker is documented as meaningful only under energy aware scheduling.

Next buddy selection records a preferred entity for future scheduling decisions. Requests for absent or delayed entities are ignored with a diagnostic expectation, idle entities are never recorded, and valid requests overwrite any prior preference.

The fair queue object as observed carries aggregate weight and load, queued and hierarchical runnable queued and idle counts, current plus hierarchical current plus next entity references, leaf and throttled list membership, nested throttle depth, runtime enabled plus remaining runtime, PELT and self throttled clocks and accumulations, and a limbo list for parked tasks.

The scheduling entity as observed carries virtual time plus deadline plus relative deadline plus slice context, lag and weight and hierarchical load, present plus delayed plus idle markers, execution start and accumulated execution plus prior baseline, and group linkage used for hierarchical traversal and ordering.

Throttling related task state as observed includes class identity plus exiting and input wait flags, a boolean throttled marker, a throttle list node distinct from normal queue linkage, a throttle work item for deferred parking, and an embedded fair entity that determines queue ownership.

Several paths defend against inconsistent or out of range state. Empty total load during lag scaling, negative throttled clock deltas, unthrottle requests for unthrottled or runtime exhausted queues, unexpected positive runtime remainder during distribution, parking of non current or wrong class or exiting tasks, recording of absent or delayed buddies, and requeue of non delayed or non present entities each trigger diagnostic expectations with clamped or early exit handling rather than proceeding.

Flag identities ENQUEUE_WAKEUP plus ENQUEUE_DELAYED plus ENQUEUE_MIGRATED plus ENQUEUE_INITIAL plus DEQUEUE_SLEEP plus DEQUEUE_THROTTLE distinguish arrival and removal causes. Wakeup versus new controls utilization and overutilized treatment, delayed selects requeue handling, migrated clears hotness, initial selects reduced deadline distance, and sleep versus throttle select limbo versus hierarchy removal, with numeric encodings not shown here.

Weight anchor NICE_0_LOAD provides the reference for hierarchical share derivation and for conversion between virtual distance and real interval. Hierarchy walks begin from this anchor and tick intervals scale by entity weight relative to it, with numeric value not shown in these fragments.

Throttled fast path enqueue excludes the current donor even when its hierarchy is throttled. This preserves correct group linkage for tasks concurrently undergoing group changes on the same processor and forces such tasks through a real enqueue with the throttled marker cleared instead of direct limbo insertion.
